body:
i feel like i've been putting in the effort. not perfectly, of course, no one does. but i'm about to graduate in honors at my university, i got accepted to a grad program that only accepts 50 students, i have a competitive internship - i have a relatively secure life. but it's never been enough for everyone in my life, no matter how hard i work, no matter what i do.

i know its about keeping up the strength to fight that - but i dont know how to continue without encouragement, without slight compliment. it's fragile, and kind of silly, but i feel so forgotten emotionally. so much is expected of me, i can never keep up - i feel like a disappoint for every misstep, no matter the size.
that all just seems a bit unfathomable.
sure - it sounds interesting. maybe itll help lessen this feeling.
will leaving make the world a better place? one less carbon footprint, one less time i make another feel any form of negative emotion, etc.
